name: X-Men: Evolution
description: Teenagers Cyclops, Jean Grey, Rogue, Nightcrawler, Shadowcat, and Spike fight for a world that fears and hates them.

videos.title: Strategy X
videos.overview: Mystique sees an opportunity to get a spy in Xavier's institute when the morally shady Todd Tolanski starts exhibiting mutant powers. Kurt Wagner, Xavier's latest recruit, arrives and tries to familiarize himself with his new life as part of the X-Men.

videos.title: The X-Impulse
videos.overview: 15-year-old Kitty Pryde wakes up one day and finds herself able to walk though objects. She tries to ignore it, but finds that hard when she's approached by Jean Grey and a mutant trouble maker, who both say they know what she's going through and want to help her. Meanwhile Wolverine's old nemesis, Sabertooth, arrives in town - looking for trouble.

videos.title: Rogue Recruit
videos.overview: After being kept in the dark about her powers for years, a young female mutant touches a fellow student and absorbs his strength, his memories - his life. Afraid and confused, and unable to differentiate her memories from the absorbed ones she runs away - straight in to the hands of Mystique.

videos.title: Mutant Crush
videos.overview: The only thing bigger than Fred Dukes' strength and size, is his temper, which makes his first day at school rather difficult. When Jean Grey makes contact, trying to be friendly, he takes it just a bit to seriously.

videos.title: Speed and Spyke
videos.overview: Ororo's nephew starts exhibiting mutant powers, but he's more interested in settling a rivalry with a fellow mutant than hearing about a ""school for freaks"".

videos.title: Middleverse
videos.overview: Kurt accidently finds an abandoned lab, and is sucked into a pocket dimension by a strange device he finds there.

videos.title: Turn of the Rogue
videos.overview: Scott and Rogue end up on a geology club field trip together. Scott tries to be friendly to her, but it turns out Mystique has other plans...

videos.title: SpykeCam
videos.overview: As an extra credit project, Evan is given a camera to record the ""current events"" in his life. Though most of them aren't keen on being caught on tape, Sabertooth is most definitively interested in the result.

videos.title: Survival of the Fittest
videos.overview: While the X-Men are at a summer camp, learning survival training, Mystique releases Cain Marko - the unstoppable Juggernaut - in hopes of getting his help in obtaining Xavier's mutant location system.

videos.title: Shadowed Past
videos.overview: Rogue's nightmares seem to show images from Kurt's past, but in them he's far too young to remember. So where did they come from?

videos.title: Grim Reminder
videos.overview: A news report from the Canadian mountains triggers something deep inside Wolverine, and he starts having berserk fits. To find out why, he takes the Blackbird to the site, not knowing that Kitty and Kurt are sitting in the back.

videos.title: The Cauldron (1)
videos.overview: As mysterious metal pods appear, picking up the mutants one at a time, Cerebro detects a new mutant in Hawaii: Alex Summers - Scott's believed to be deceased brother.

videos.title: The Cauldron (2)
videos.overview: Magneto reveals the his plans for the winners of his challenge - to fully unlock their powers with a machine he has built. Back at the mansion, those left behind regroup, and decide to pay Magneto a little visit.

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: When Cyclops and Nightcrawler save people from a car crash they question Xavier's desire to keep their identities a secret. Meanwhile, the Brotherhood terrorize people in a crowded stadium.

videos.title: Bada-Bing Bada-Boom
videos.overview: Nightcrawler has a crush on a new student. The wild girl is grounded for breaking the rules, but things get worse when her father arrives and asks that she help him in a bank robbery.

videos.title: Power Surge
videos.overview: Jean's telepathy changes, arriving in surges she can't control; and Hank McCoy joins the faculty as a science-and-gym teacher.

videos.title: Fun and Games
videos.overview: The young X-Men are left alone in the mansion when the adults respond to a jailbreak, and they throw a party that doesn't end well.

videos.title: The Beast of Bayville
videos.overview: The serum Hank McCoy uses to control his mutation no longer works, and his students are afraid of his angry outbursts.

videos.title: Adrift
videos.overview: Havok is swept out to sea while surfing in Hawaii, and Scott saves him, but they both end up stranded and have to work together to survive.

videos.title: African Storm
videos.overview: The X-Men help Storm when her abilities are threatened by a visiting African witch doctor who attempts to steal her powers.

videos.title: Joyride
videos.overview: Avalanche wants to join the Institute, but has trouble being accepted by the others, especially after he's accused of taking joyrides on the X-vehicles at night.

videos.title: On Angel's Wings
videos.overview: Xavier suspects that a flying "angel" seen above New York is a mutant, and he sends Cyclops and Rogue to find him before Magneto does.

videos.title: Mindbender
videos.overview: Jean is possessed by a mutant with telepathic powers, which he uses to control the students and have them help him in his plot to release the imprisoned Apocalypse, a mutant who wishes to enslave the human race.

videos.title: Shadow Dance
videos.overview: Forge invents a teleporter, and Nightcrawler uses it to travel large distances, but inadvertently opens a portal that allows strange creatures to follow him back to the school.

videos.title: Retreat
videos.overview: Beast is mistaken for Bigfoot by hunters while he's on a camping trip with the students.

videos.title: Walk on the Wild Side
videos.overview: The women form a team of crime fighters after Jean and Amara are teased for having weaker powers, and they call themselves the Bayville Sirens.

videos.title: Operation: Rebirth
videos.overview: Magneto steals plans for a top-secret project that produced super soldiers. Wolverine worked on it during World War II.

videos.title: The HeX Factor
videos.overview: Mystique frees a mutant called the Scarlet Witch from an asylum, hoping she'll help the Brotherhood, but Mystique doesn't know the witch is seeking revenge on Quicksilver and Magneto.

videos.title: Day of Reckoning (1)
videos.overview: At Xavier's urging, the Brotherhood and the X-Men unite to battle Magneto; and the Institute begins to self-destruct while students are trapped in the mansion.

videos.title: Day of Reckoning (2)
videos.overview: A traitor in the battle threatens the efforts of the X-Men and the Brotherhood against Magneto, who has another secret weapon -- the Sentinel robot.

videos.title: Day of Recovery
videos.overview: X-Men and the Brotherhood deal with the aftermath of the world finding out about mutants. The Institute is blown up, and Mystique posed as Prof. X to blow it up. Some of the X-Men and Brotherhood are captured, leaving the mutants that escaped to find them and the Professor.

videos.title: The Stuff of Heroes
videos.overview: Rogue and Wolverine duck a squad of soldiers when the nationwide alert goes out against mutants, while Storm and Beast go into a meeting of Congress to defend themselves. Meanwhile Juggernaut goes on a rampage and the X-Men feel obliged to take him down.

videos.title: Mainstream
videos.overview: During the rebuilding of the manor, Kitty and Kurt intercept a bunch of graffiti artists disguised as monsters. The older students get to go back to Bayville High for one day before attending a hearing to determine their ultimate fate, while they are banned from using their powers.

videos.title: The Stuff of Villains
videos.overview: Wanda goes searching for Pietro. Meanwhile the brotherhood's members are expelled from school, much to Lance's dismay.

videos.title: Blind Alley
videos.overview: Mystique escapes from imprisonment while the X-Men repair and rebuild the Institute. Disguised as Alex, she lures Scott into a trap - leaving him stranded in the middle of the Mexican desert without his glasses.

videos.title: X-Treme Measures
videos.overview: Evan enters an extreme Skateboarding competition, and puts his skills to the test. But something is wrong: A mysterious woman is watching and following him during the competition.

videos.title: The Toad, The Witch, and the Wardrobe
videos.overview: Wanda receives a clue from one of Magneto's minions, Pyro, directing her to a ski resort. Meanwhile, Kurt is meeting Amanda's parents for the first time, and the Toad believes he can use Kurt's holo-inducer to disguise himself and win Wanda's love.

videos.title: Self Possessed
videos.overview: Rogue begins to lose control of all the people she's ever absorbed as they fight to take over. She discovers unsettling information about Mystique. Scott and Jean go on a date... or do they?

videos.title: Under Lock and Key
videos.overview: Mesmero mentally controls Gambit into stealing half of the Spider Stone from Angel.

videos.title: X23
videos.overview: A mysterious female assassin terrorizes the X-Mansion, knocking out the X-Men one by one. Wolverine finds out that it is his clone, created by the Dr. Deborah Risman and raised without love by HYDRA, and she wants to kill him because she holds him responsible for her miserable life. Wolverine and X-23, as she is called, square off in a battle that Wolverine does not want to win.

videos.title: Dark Horizon (1)
videos.overview: As Jean's and Scott's graduation day approaches, Rogue suddenly leaves the mansion.

videos.title: Dark Horizon (2)
videos.overview: As all the monsters in the tomb attack, the teammates fight to survive and find a way out.

videos.title: Cruise Control
videos.overview: The X-Men are on vacation with Storm as their guardian. Amara falls ill while on the ship.

videos.title: Impact
videos.overview: The X-Men pursue Apocalypse in Mexico, hoping to find and overcome him before Magneto finds him.

videos.title: No Good Deed
videos.overview: The Brotherhood cause mishaps so they can stop them and appear to be heroes.

videos.title: Target X
videos.overview: Wolverine finds his clone, X-23, who's trying to destroy Hydra, her creator, and the two team up to complete the mission.

videos.title: Sins of the Son
videos.overview: Xavier is told he has a son, who has been kidnapped in Scotland. So he and the X-Men head there to find him.

videos.title: Uprising
videos.overview: Hate crimes against mutants in Bayville prompt Spyke to return to stop the violence.

videos.title: Cajun Spice
videos.overview: Rogue is kidnapped by Gambit, who says he's there to help her; and the X-Men search for her, led by Wolverine.

videos.title: Ghost of a Chance
videos.overview: Kitty is rescued by a mutant and invites her to join the institute. But the mutant soon vanishes, and only Kitty remembers her.

videos.title: Ascension (1)
videos.overview: Xavier finds Apocalypse in Egypt, and Apocalypse unleashes four horsemen, who battle the X-Men.

videos.title: Ascension (2)
videos.overview: The battle against Apocalypse rages as X-Men, the Brotherhood, and Acolytes join forces to stop him from turning all humans into mutants.
